# FIXTURE: bad-02 — long frame (5 words + לֵאמֹר) with speech on the SAME line
# Violation: long frame (≥4 prosodic words) collapsed with speech content on one line
# Rule: H5/speech-framing, STRONG-SPLIT-CANDIDATE
# Expected: ≥1 finding with severity STRONG-SPLIT-CANDIDATE

1:1
וַיְהִי דְּבַר יְהוָה אֶל יוֹנָה בֶן אֲמִתַּי לֵאמֹר קוּם לֵךְ אֶל נִינְוֵה׃
